description.zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

默认查询所有应用ID。
description.en:
The ID of the application. You can specify only one ID.

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all your applications is returned.

description.zh:
查询数据结束时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

The end time must be later than the start time.

The time granularity of the query, in seconds.

Valid values are **3600** (1 hour) and **86400** (1 day). The default value is **3600**.
The area where the service is deployed. The default value is CN, which indicates China.

description.zh: 查询数据起始时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

title.zh: 获取按照音视频规格进行统计累计通信时长
title.en: Retrieve cumulative communication duration statistics by audio and video specifications

descriptions.zh: > 数据查询的起止时间跨度最大为30天。
descriptions.en: > The maximum query time range is 30 days.
